title: Nonzero relative differential value of a section
statement: Let $p:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq X$ an open subset, $z\in U$, and $a\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$. Let $d:\mathcal O_X\to\Omega^1_{X/S}$ be the universal relative derivation [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. The relative differential value predicate means $(da)_z\otimes 1\ne0$ in $(\Omega^1_{X/S})_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,z}}\kappa(z)$, using module germs and stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], the residue field [def-weil-residue-field], its module structure induced by the residue homomorphism, and the module tensor product [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product].
